title: The Adventure Begins
logline: When eager young Keen sails away from home and into a storm, he discovers that courage is not looking fearless — it is hearing someone else need him, feeling the gulp, and going anyway.

orderedEvents.text: Tall flowers sway gently in the warm breeze. Some stretch high above the grass, with long soft necks and bright open petals full of pollen. FUZZBY and ZENNY weave between them collecting pollen from flower to flower. Fine golden pollen dusts their paws and trails softly through the air. Zenny works with smooth calm precision — neat, efficient, graceful. Fuzzby does not. He zig-zags wildly through the air, humming loudly to himself as he works.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…
He dips low into a flower, scoops up pollen — then overdoes it and spins sideways into a leaf. FWIP. He bounces back into the air and straightens up proudly.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: Nailed it.
Zenny glides up beside him. Watches him for a beat.

beats.storyBeat: The episode opens at bee scale in a bright flower field: Zenny’s graceful competence and Fuzzby’s chaotic overconfidence are instantly legible. Fuzzby’s first pollen dive becomes a crash he rebrands as mastery, planting the whole episode’s comic idea that bravado is not the same as courage.
beats.want: Fuzzby wants to collect pollen like an impressive professional and be seen doing it.
beats.need: He needs to know he belongs even when his body betrays his grand self-image.
beats.kidRead: Funny bee zooms too fast, hits a leaf, bounces back and pretends he meant it.
beats.adultRead: A tiny performer is already covering embarrassment with status — lovable because the mask is transparent.
beats.emotionalIntent: Start with easy laughter, high energy and immediate character contrast, with no danger yet beyond Fuzzby’s own momentum.

inputs.logline: When eager young Keen sails away from home and into a storm, he discovers that courage is not looking fearless — it is hearing someone else need him, feeling the gulp, and going anyway.

orderedEvents.text: Tall flowers sway gently in the warm breeze. Some stretch high above the grass, with long soft necks and bright open petals full of pollen. FUZZBY and ZENNY weave between them collecting pollen from flower to flower. Fine golden pollen dusts their paws and trails softly through the air. Zenny works with smooth calm precision — neat, efficient, graceful. Fuzzby does not. He zig-zags wildly through the air, humming loudly to himself as he works.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…
He dips low into a flower, scoops up pollen — then overdoes it and spins sideways into a leaf. FWIP. He bounces back into the air and straightens up proudly.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: Nailed it.
Zenny glides up beside him. Watches him for a beat.

beats.storyBeat: The episode opens at bee scale in a bright flower field: Zenny’s graceful competence and Fuzzby’s chaotic overconfidence are instantly legible. Fuzzby’s first pollen dive becomes a crash he rebrands as mastery, planting the whole episode’s comic idea that bravado is not the same as courage.

beats.need: He needs to know he belongs even when his body betrays his grand self-image.
beats.kidRead: Funny bee zooms too fast, hits a leaf, bounces back and pretends he meant it.
beats.adultRead: A tiny performer is already covering embarrassment with status — lovable because the mask is transparent.
beats.emotionalIntent: Start with easy laughter, high energy and immediate character contrast, with no danger yet beyond Fuzzby’s own momentum.
